results.methodology: Same-process runs of real plugin engine scripts (docs/memory-phase2/ROADMAP.md T1-T4), the method of the first gate: engines and ScriptRuntime are tracked from EngineLifecycleCallback through weak references, and so are the host-side bridge session objects that BridgeExecutionObserver reports at creation (T1 (a)). After every run the runner collects and polls up to pollMs (1 s once 3 runs stayed reachable); a final collection decides 'retained'. Heap deltas compare the sample after the last warm-up with the final sample; thread, Rhino context, engine and bridge registry deltas compare with the sample before the first run (the plugin probe already bound the plugin), bridge threads with the end of the warm-ups. Bridge registries must return to the start except the Node connection pool, which may keep one idle connection; system-side connections of this process to the plugin packages (LoadedApk.mServices, hidden_api_policy 1) may be one above the start. Plugin process PSS is recorded after the second measured run and at the end, never judged (R9). Force mode waits for gateReady(), sleeps forceDelayMs and calls forceStop on every live engine of the run on the main thread.
